title: Find a free cool space near you on a hot day
summary: The Mayor's Cool Spaces map lists libraries, community centres and other public places where anyone can rest and cool down during hot weather.
details: Map is live 1 June to 30 September each year
Includes indoor air-conditioned spaces and outdoor spaces with shade, seating, water and toilets
Spaces are sorted into two tiers by the amenities they offer
Not a medical service – if someone is unwell from the heat, get medical help

sources.title: Greater London Authority: Cool Spaces map

verification.flag_reason: Freshness: the Cool Spaces map is seasonal and closes on 30 September 2026 – removed by editor choice; re-check next June.

title: Thames Water hosepipe ban: what you can and can't do
summary: A hosepipe ban is in place for Thames Water customers during the dry spell. It lifts when river, groundwater and reservoir levels recover.
details: No hosepipes, sprinklers or pressure washers for gardens, pools, cars or patios
Watering cans, water butts, buckets and reused household water are all fine
Exemptions include disability or medical needs and animal welfare
Page last updated 17 September 2026 – check before assuming it's still on

verification.flag_reason: Freshness: the hosepipe ban is temporary and lifts when conditions allow – removed by editor choice so the site doesn't show a stale restriction.
